assessment: This is an important article as it is the first to use a reconstituted translation system to study competition among mRNAs for the initiation machinery. Understanding the principles of the biochemistry of mRNA competition for initiation factors cannot be achieved without such a system. The authors provide compelling evidence that Ded1 is required for efficient initiation of highly structured mRNAs. The findings are significant and validate the in vitro reconstituted system by recapitulating the effects of in vivo perturbations of translation initiation by Ded1 mutants.
